4.4.m: 'Due to diseases of the son's teeth and eyes, alas, what misery, what shall I do? / The cows are lost, the farming is ruined, the bulls have fled somewhere!'

4.4.s:
amī prāghūrṇakāḥ prāptā bhaktacchede ca me gṛhe ..
bālāpatyā ca me bhāryā kaḥ kariṣyati raṃdhanam .. .. 129 ..
4.4.d:
अमी प्राघूर्णकाः प्राप्ता भक्तच्छेदे च मे गृहे ॥
बालापत्या च मे भार्या कः करिष्यति रंधनम् ॥ ॥ 129 ॥
4.4.m: "These guests have arrived, and there is no cooked food in my house; / my wife has small children—who will do the cooking?"

4.4.s:
pradānakāle kanyāyāḥ kīdṛśaśca varo bhavet ..
iti cintābhibhūtānāṃ kutaḥ saukhyaṃ kuṭubinām .. 4.4.130 ..
4.4.d:
प्रदानकाले कन्यायाः कीदृशश्च वरो भवेत् ॥
इति चिन्ताभिभूतानां कुतः सौख्यं कुटुबिनाम् ॥ 4.4.130 ॥
4.4.m: "At the time of giving away the maiden, what kind of groom will he be?" / Overcome by such anxiety, whence can there be happiness for householders?

4.4.s:
kuṭuṃbaciṃtākulitasya puṃsaḥ śrutaṃ ca śīlaṃ ca guṇāśca sarve ..
apakvakuṃbhe nihitā ivāpaḥ prayāṃti dehena samaṃ vināśam ..131..
4.4.d:
कुटुंबचिंताकुलितस्य पुंसः श्रुतं च शीलं च गुणाश्च सर्वे ॥
अपक्वकुंभे निहिता इवापः प्रयांति देहेन समं विनाशम् ॥131॥
4.4.m: For a man distressed by household worries, sacred learning, character, and all virtues / perish along with the body, like water poured into an unbaked pot.

4.4.s:
rājyepi ca mahadduḥkhaṃ saṃdhivigrahaciṃtayā ..
putrādapi bhayaṃ yatra tatra saukhyaṃ hi kīdṛśam ..132..
4.4.d:
राज्येपि च महद्दुःखं संधिविग्रहचिंतया ॥
पुत्रादपि भयं यत्र तत्र सौख्यं हि कीदृशम् ॥132॥
4.4.m: Even in kingship there is great suffering through the worry of peace and war; / where there is fear even of one's own son, what happiness can there be?

4.4.s:
sajātīyādvadhaḥ prāyaḥ sarveṣāmeva dehinām ..
ekadravyābhilāṣitvācchunāmiva parasparam .. .. 133 ..
4.4.d:
सजातीयाद्वधः प्रायः सर्वेषामेव देहिनाम् ॥
एकद्रव्याभिलाषित्वाच्छुनामिव परस्परम् ॥ ॥ 133 ॥
4.4.m: Slaughter occurs for nearly all living beings at the hands of their own kind, / out of desiring the same object, just like dogs with one another.

4.4.s:
nāpradhṛṣyabalaḥ kaścinnṛpaḥ khyātosti bhūtale ..
nikhilaṃ yastiraskṛtya sukhaṃ tiṣṭhati nirbhayaḥ .. 134 ..
4.4.d:
नाप्रधृष्यबलः कश्चिन्नृपः ख्यातोस्ति भूतले ॥
निखिलं यस्तिरस्कृत्य सुखं तिष्ठति निर्भयः ॥ 134 ॥
4.4.m: No king of unassailable might is known on the earth / who, having subdued everyone, remains fearless and happy.

4.4.s:
ā janmanaḥ prabhṛti duḥkha mayaṃ śarīraṃ karmātmakaṃ tava mayā kathitaṃ narendra ..
dānopavāsaniyamaiśca kṛtaistadeva sarvopabhogasukhabhāgbhavatīha puṃsām .. 135 ..
pāpabhedākhyānavarṇanam
4.4.d:
आ जन्मनः प्रभृति दुःख मयं शरीरं कर्मात्मकं तव मया कथितं नरेन्द्र ॥
दानोपवासनियमैश्च कृतैस्तदेव सर्वोपभोगसुखभाग्भवतीह पुंसाम् ॥ 135 ॥
पापभेदाख्यानवर्णनम्
4.4.m:
From birth onwards, O lord of men, the body is full of suffering, consisting of karma—this I have told you; / yet when performed with gifts, fasts, and observances, that very body partakes here of the happiness of all enjoyments for men.
The description explaining the divisions of sins.

4.5.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
adhodhaḥ patanaṃ puṃsāmadhaḥkarma prakīrtitam ..
narakārṇavaghoreṣu yātanā pāpamucyate .. 1 ..
4.5.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अधोधः पतनं पुंसामधःकर्म प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
नरकार्णवघोरेषु यातना पापमुच्यते ॥ 1 ॥
4.5.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Downward and downward falling of men is proclaimed as base karma; / the torment in the terrible oceans of hell is called sin.

4.5.s:
adharmabhedā vijñeyāścittavṛttiprabhedataḥ ..
sthūlāḥ sūkṣmāḥ susūkṣmāśca koṭi bhedairanekadhā .. 2 ..
4.5.d:
अधर्मभेदा विज्ञेयाश्चित्तवृत्तिप्रभेदतः ॥
स्थूलाः सूक्ष्माः सुसूक्ष्माश्च कोटि भेदैरनेकधा ॥ 2 ॥
4.5.m: The varieties of unrighteousness are to be known through the varieties of mental states— / gross, subtle, and very subtle, manifold in tens of millions of divisions.

4.5.s:
tatra ye pāpanicayāḥ sthūlā narakahetavaḥ ..
te samāsena kathyaṃte manovākkāyasādhanāḥ .. 3 ..
4.5.d:
तत्र ये पापनिचयाः स्थूला नरकहेतवः ॥
ते समासेन कथ्यंते मनोवाक्कायसाधनाः ॥ 3 ॥
4.5.m: Among them, the accumulations of gross sins that are the causes of hell, / accomplished by mind, speech, and body, are related in brief.

4.5.s:
parastrīṣvatha saṃkalpaścetasāniṣṭaciṃtanam ..
akāryābhiniveśaśca caturdhā karma mānasam.. 4 ..
4.5.d:
परस्त्रीष्वथ संकल्पश्चेतसानिष्टचिंतनम् ॥
अकार्याभिनिवेशश्च चतुर्धा कर्म मानसम्॥ 4 ॥
4.5.m: Lustful intent toward another's wife, pondering misfortune [for others] in the mind, / and adherence to what ought not to be done: mental karma is fourfold.

4.5.s:
anibaddhapralāpitvamasatyaṃ cāpriyaṃ ca yat ..
parāpavādapaiśunyaṃ caturdhā karma vācikam .. 5 ..
4.5.d:
अनिबद्धप्रलापित्वमसत्यं चाप्रियं च यत् ॥
परापवादपैशुन्यं चतुर्धा कर्म वाचिकम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.5.m: Unconnected babbling, that which is untrue and unpleasant, / slander of others, and malice: vocal karma is fourfold.

4.5.s:
abhakṣyabhakṣaṇaṃ hiṃsā mithyā kāmasya sevanam ..
parasvānāmupādānaṃ caturddhā karma kāyikam .. 6 ..
4.5.d:
अभक्ष्यभक्षणं हिंसा मिथ्या कामस्य सेवनम् ॥
परस्वानामुपादानं चतुर्द्धा कर्म कायिकम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.5.m: Eating forbidden food, violence, indulging in wrongful lust, / and taking the property of others: bodily karma is fourfold.

4.5.s:
ityetaddvādaśavidhaṃ karma proktaṃ sasādhanam ..
teṣāṃ bhedaṃ punarvacmi yeṣāṃ phalamanaṃtakam ). 7 '
ye dviṣaṃti mahādevaṃ saṃsārārṇavatāraṇam ..
samastapātakopetāste yānti narakāgniṣu ...8...
4.5.d:
इत्येतद्द्वादशविधं कर्म प्रोक्तं ससाधनम् ॥
तेषां भेदं पुनर्वच्मि येषां फलमनंतकम् ). 7 '
ये द्विषंति महादेवं संसारार्णवतारणम् ॥
समस्तपातकोपेतास्ते यान्ति नरकाग्निषु ॥.8॥।
4.5.m: Thus this karma is stated to be of twelve kinds along with its means. / I shall tell further the division of those whose fruit is endless. / Those who hate Mahādeva, the deliverer across the ocean of saṃsāra, / endowed with all sins, go into the fires of hell.

4.5.s:
brahmaghnaśca surāpaśca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ ..
mahāpātakinaścaite tatsaṃsargī ca paṃcamaḥ .. 9 ..
4.5.d:
ब्रह्मघ्नश्च सुरापश्च स्तेयी च गुरुतल्पगः ॥
महापातकिनश्चैते तत्संसर्गी च पंचमः ॥ 9 ॥
4.5.m: The killer of a brāhmaṇa, the drinker of liquor, the thief, and the violator of the guru's bed— / these are the perpetrators of great sins, and the fifth is one who associates with them.

4.5.s:
krodhāddveṣādbhayāllobhādbrāhmaṇaṃ viśasaṃti ye ..
prāṇāṃtiko mahādoṣo brahmaghnāste prakīrtitāḥ... 4.5.10..
4.5.d:
क्रोधाद्द्वेषाद्भयाल्लोभाद्ब्राह्मणं विशसंति ये ॥
प्राणांतिको महादोषो ब्रह्मघ्नास्ते प्रकीर्तिताः॥। 4.5.10॥
4.5.m: Those who slaughter a brāhmaṇa out of anger, hatred, fear, or greed— / a great sin that ends life—they are proclaimed as killers of brāhmaṇas.

4.5.s:
brāhmaṇaṃ ca samāhūya yācamānamakiñcanam ..
paścānnāstīti taṃ brūyātsa caivaṃ brahmahā smṛtaḥ .. 11 ..
4.5.d:
ब्राह्मणं च समाहूय याचमानमकिञ्चनम् ॥
पश्चान्नास्तीति तं ब्रूयात्स चैवं ब्रह्महा स्मृतः ॥ 11 ॥
4.5.m: And having summoned a destitute brāhmaṇa who is begging, / if one afterwards says to him, "There is nothing," he too is considered a killer of a brāhmaṇa.

4.5.s:
yastu vidyābhimānena nityaṃ jayati vai dvijān ..
samāsīnaḥ sabhāmadhye brahmahā so'pi kīrtitaḥ..12..
4.5.d:
यस्तु विद्याभिमानेन नित्यं जयति वै द्विजान् ॥
समासीनः सभामध्ये ब्रह्महा सोऽपि कीर्तितः॥12॥
4.5.m: He who, out of pride in his learning, constantly defeats twice-born men / while seated in the midst of an assembly, he too is proclaimed a killer of a brāhmaṇa.

4.5.s:
mithyāguṇaiḥ svamātmānaṃ nayatyutkarṣaṇaṃ balāt..
gurūṇāṃ ca viruddho yaḥ sa caiva brahmahā smṛtaḥ..
kṣuttṛṭsaṃtaptadehānāṃ dvijānāṃ bhoktumicchatām..
samācarati yo vighnaṃ tamāhurbrahmaghātakam..14..
4.5.d:
मिथ्यागुणैः स्वमात्मानं नयत्युत्कर्षणं बलात्॥
गुरूणां च विरुद्धो यः स चैव ब्रह्महा स्मृतः॥
क्षुत्तृट्संतप्तदेहानां द्विजानां भोक्तुमिच्छताम्॥
समाचरति यो विघ्नं तमाहुर्ब्रह्मघातकम्॥14॥
4.5.m: He who forcibly elevates himself with false virtues, / and he who is hostile to his gurus, is also considered a killer of a brāhmaṇa; / he who causes obstruction to twice-born men whose bodies are afflicted with hunger and thirst and who wish to eat, / him they call a slayer of a brāhmaṇa.

4.5.s:
piśunaḥ sarvalokānāṃ chidrānveṣaṇatatparaḥ ..
udvegajananaḥ krūraḥ sa caiva brahmahā smṛtaḥ .. 15 ..
4.5.d:
पिशुनः सर्वलोकानां छिद्रान्वेषणतत्परः ॥
उद्वेगजननः क्रूरः स चैव ब्रह्महा स्मृतः ॥ 15 ॥
4.5.m: A slanderer of all people, intent on seeking out weaknesses, / causing anxiety, cruel—he too is considered a killer of a brāhmaṇa.

4.5.s:
gavāṃ tṛṣṇābhibhūtānāṃ jalārthamupasarpatām ..
samācarati yo vighnaṃ sa caiva brahmahā smṛtaḥ .. 16 ..
4.5.d:
गवां तृष्णाभिभूतानां जलार्थमुपसर्पताम् ॥
समाचरति यो विघ्नं स चैव ब्रह्महा स्मृतः ॥ 16 ॥
4.5.m: He who causes obstruction to cows overcome with thirst / as they approach for water, he too is considered a killer of a brāhmaṇa.

4.5.s:
paradoṣamabhijñāya nṛpakarṇe karoti yaḥ ..
pāpīyānpiśunaḥ kṣudraḥ sa caiva brahmahā smṛtaḥ .. 17 ...
4.5.d:
परदोषमभिज्ञाय नृपकर्णे करोति यः ॥
पापीयान्पिशुनः क्षुद्रः स चैव ब्रह्महा स्मृतः ॥ 17 ॥।
4.5.m: He who, discovering another's fault, pours it into the king's ear, / wicked, malicious, base—he too is considered a killer of a brāhmaṇa.

4.5.s:
devadvijagavāṃ bhūmiṃ pūrvabhuktā harettu yaḥ ..
pranaṣṭāmapi kālena tamāhurbrahmaghātakam .. 18 ..
4.5.d:
देवद्विजगवां भूमिं पूर्वभुक्ता हरेत्तु यः ॥
प्रनष्टामपि कालेन तमाहुर्ब्रह्मघातकम् ॥ 18 ॥
4.5.m: He who seizes the land of gods, twice-born men, and cows that was previously enjoyed, / even if lost over time, him they call a slayer of a brāhmaṇa.

4.5.s:
dvijavittāpaharaṇe nyāyataḥ samupārjite ..
brahmahatyā samaṃ jñeyaṃ pātakaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 19 ..
4.5.d:
द्विजवित्तापहरणे न्यायतः समुपार्जिते ॥
ब्रह्महत्या समं ज्ञेयं पातकं नात्र संशयः ॥ 19 ॥
4.5.m: In stealing the wealth of a twice-born man acquired lawfully, / the sin is to be known as equal to the killing of a brāhmaṇa; there is no doubt about this.

4.5.s:
agnihotraparityāgo yastu yājñikakarmaṇām ..
mātāpitṛparityāgaḥ kūṭasākṣyaṃ suhṛdvadhaḥ .. 4.5.20 ..
4.5.d:
अग्निहोत्रपरित्यागो यस्तु याज्ञिककर्मणाम् ॥
मातापितृपरित्यागः कूटसाक्ष्यं सुहृद्वधः ॥ 4.5.20 ॥
4.5.m: Abandonment of the agnihotra on the part of those performing sacrifices, / abandonment of mother and father, false testimony, murder of a friend,

4.5.s:
gavāṃ mārge vane cāgniṃ pure grāme ca dīpayet ..
iti pāpāni ghorāṇi surāpānasamāni tu .. 21 ..
4.5.d:
गवां मार्गे वने चाग्निं पुरे ग्रामे च दीपयेत् ॥
इति पापानि घोराणि सुरापानसमानि तु ॥ 21 ॥
4.5.m: kindling a fire on a path of cows, in a forest, in a city, or in a village— / such terrible sins are equal to drinking liquor.

4.5.s:
hīnasvaharaṇe cāpi narastrīgajavājinām ..
gobhūrajataratnānāmauṣadhīnāṃ rajasya ca .. 22 ..
4.5.d:
हीनस्वहरणे चापि नरस्त्रीगजवाजिनाम् ॥
गोभूरजतरत्नानामौषधीनां रजस्य च ॥ 22 ॥
4.5.m: In stealing what is inferior, and also men, women, elephants, and horses, / cows, land, silver, jewels, medicinal herbs, and dust,

4.5.s:
caṃdanāgarukarpūrakastūrīkhaṇḍavāsasām ..
haste nyasyāpaharaṇaṃ rukmasteyasamaṃ smṛtam .. 23 ..
4.5.d:
चंदनागरुकर्पूरकस्तूरीखण्डवाससाम् ॥
हस्ते न्यस्यापहरणं रुक्मस्तेयसमं स्मृतम् ॥ 23 ॥
4.5.m: sandalwood, agallochum, camphor, musk, pieces of cloth— / seizing what was placed in one's hand is remembered as equal to the theft of gold.

4.5.s:
kanyānāṃ varayogyānāmadānaṃ sadṛśe vare ..
putramitrakalatreṣu gamanaṃ bhaginīṣu ca .. 24 ..
4.5.d:
कन्यानां वरयोग्यानामदानं सदृशे वरे ॥
पुत्रमित्रकलत्रेषु गमनं भगिनीषु च ॥ 24 ॥
4.5.m: Not giving maidens fit for a groom to a suitable groom, / going to the wives of sons and friends, and to sisters,

4.5.s:
kumārīsāhasaṃ ghoramantyajastrīniṣevaṇam ..
avarṇāyāśca gamanaṃ gurutalpasamaṃ smṛtam .. 25 ..
4.5.d:
कुमारीसाहसं घोरमन्त्यजस्त्रीनिषेवणम् ॥
अवर्णायाश्च गमनं गुरुतल्पसमं स्मृतम् ॥ 25 ॥
4.5.m: violating an unmarried girl, enjoying an outcaste woman, / and going to a woman of no caste is considered equal to violating the guru's bed.

4.5.s:
mahāpātakatulyāni pāpānyuktāni yāni tu ..
tāni pātakasaṃjñāni tadvadāmyupapātakam .. 26 ..
4.5.d:
महापातकतुल्यानि पापान्युक्तानि यानि तु ॥
तानि पातकसंज्ञानि तद्वदाम्युपपातकम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.5.m: Those sins that have been stated as equal to the great sins / are termed pātaka; now I shall tell of the secondary sins.

4.5.s:
dvijārthaṃ ca pratijñāya na prayacchati yaḥ punaḥ ..
tasmānnarapate vighnatulyaṃ tadupapātakam .. 27 ..
4.5.d:
द्विजार्थं च प्रतिज्ञाय न प्रयच्छति यः पुनः ॥
तस्मान्नरपते विघ्नतुल्यं तदुपपातकम् ॥ 27 ॥
4.5.m: He who promises [a gift] for the sake of a twice-born man and then does not give it, / therefore, O lord of men, that is a secondary sin equal to an obstruction.

4.5.s:
dvijadravyāpaharaṇaṃ maryādāyā vyatikramaḥ ..
atikopaśca mānaśca dāṃbhikatvaṃ kṛtaghnatā .. 28 ..
4.5.d:
द्विजद्रव्यापहरणं मर्यादाया व्यतिक्रमः ॥
अतिकोपश्च मानश्च दांभिकत्वं कृतघ्नता ॥ 28 ॥
4.5.m: Seizing the property of a twice-born man, transgression of bounds, / excessive anger, arrogance, deceitfulness, ingratitude,

4.5.s:
atyaṃtaviṣayāsaktiḥ kārpaṇyaṃ śreṣṭhamatsaraḥ ..
paradārāpaharaṇaṃ sādhukanyāvidūṣaṇam .. 29 ..
4.5.d:
अत्यंतविषयासक्तिः कार्पण्यं श्रेष्ठमत्सरः ॥
परदारापहरणं साधुकन्याविदूषणम् ॥ 29 ॥
4.5.m: extreme attachment to sense-objects, miserliness, malice toward the eminent, / abduction of another's wife, defiling a virtuous maiden,

4.5.s:
parivittiḥ parīvettā yayā ca parividyate ..
tayorddānaṃ ca kanyāyāstayoreva ca yājanam .. 4.5.30 ..
4.5.d:
परिवित्तिः परीवेत्ता यया च परिविद्यते ॥
तयोर्द्दानं च कन्यायास्तयोरेव च याजनम् ॥ 4.5.30 ॥
4.5.m: the unmarried elder brother, the younger brother who marries first, and she through whom he marries first, / giving a maiden to them, and officiating at a sacrifice for them,

4.5.s:
putramitrakalatrāṇāmabhāve svāminastathā ..
śiṣṭānāṃ caiva saṃnyāsaḥ sahajānāṃ tapasvinām .. 31 ..
4.5.d:
पुत्रमित्रकलत्राणामभावे स्वामिनस्तथा ॥
शिष्टानां चैव संन्यासः सहजानां तपस्विनाम् ॥ 31 ॥
4.5.m: renunciation [of them] by the master in the absence of [other provision for] sons, friends, and wives, / and likewise for virtuous dependents and ascetic family members,

4.5.s:
bhaṃgaśca dharmakṛtyānāṃ sahāyānāṃ vināśanam ..
pīḍāmāśramasaṃsthānānnācarettvalpikāmapi .. 32 ..
4.5.d:
भंगश्च धर्मकृत्यानां सहायानां विनाशनम् ॥
पीडामाश्रमसंस्थानान्नाचरेत्त्वल्पिकामपि ॥ 32 ॥
4.5.m: interruption of righteous acts, the destruction of companions— / one should not inflict even the slightest torment on those dwelling in hermitages—

4.5.s:
svabhṛtyaparivargasya paśudhānyadhanasya ca ..
kupyadhānyapaśusteyamayācyānāṃ ca yācanam .. 33 ..
4.5.d:
स्वभृत्यपरिवर्गस्य पशुधान्यधनस्य च ॥
कुप्यधान्यपशुस्तेयमयाच्यानां च याचनम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.5.m: of one's own servants and retainers, of cattle, grain, and wealth; / the theft of base metals, grain, and cattle, and begging from those from whom one should not beg;

4.5.s:
gavāṃ kṣatriyaveśyānāṃ strīśūdrāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
yajñārāmataḍāgānāṃ dārāpatyasya vikrayaḥ ..
tīrthayātropavāsānāṃ vratāyatanakarmaṇām .. 34 ..
4.5.d:
गवां क्षत्रियवेश्यानां स्त्रीशूद्राणां विशेषतः ॥
यज्ञारामतडागानां दारापत्यस्य विक्रयः ॥
तीर्थयात्रोपवासानां व्रतायतनकर्मणाम् ॥ 34 ॥
4.5.m: the selling of cows, kṣatriyas, and vaiśyas, and especially of women and śūdras, / of sacrifices, groves, and reservoirs, of wife and offspring, / of pilgrimages, fasts, votive observances, shrines, and sacred acts;

4.5.s:
strīdhanānyupajīvaṃti strībhiratyaṃtanirjitāḥ ..
arakṣaṇaṃ ca nārīṇāṃ madyapastrīniṣevaṇam .. 35 ..
4.5.d:
स्त्रीधनान्युपजीवंति स्त्रीभिरत्यंतनिर्जिताः ॥
अरक्षणं च नारीणां मद्यपस्त्रीनिषेवणम् ॥ 35 ॥
4.5.m: living off a woman's wealth, being thoroughly subjugated by women, / failing to protect women, and consorting with a woman who drinks liquor—

4.5.s:
ṛṇānāmapradānaṃ ca dhānyavṛddhyupajīvinām ..
niṃditācca dhanādānamapaṇyānāṃ ca vikrayaḥ .. 36 ..
4.5.d:
ऋणानामप्रदानं च धान्यवृद्ध्युपजीविनाम् ॥
निंदिताच्च धनादानमपण्यानां च विक्रयः ॥ 36 ॥
4.5.m: And non-repayment of debts by those living on usury of grain, / taking wealth from a censured person, and selling forbidden goods;

4.5.s:
viṣamāraṇamaṃtrāṇāṃ prayogo mūlakarmaṇām ..
uccāṭanāvicāraśca garavidveṣaṇakriyā .. 37 ..
4.5.d:
विषमारणमंत्राणां प्रयोगो मूलकर्मणाम् ॥
उच्चाटनाविचारश्च गरविद्वेषणक्रिया ॥ 37 ॥
4.5.m: The use of mantras for poison and killing, practices of root-sorcery, / spells to drive people away and bewitch them, and rites of poisoning and creating hatred;

4.5.s:
jihvāsamupabhogārthaṃ yasyārambhaḥ svakarmasu ..
mūlyenādhyāpayedyaśca mūlyenādhīyate ca ye .. 38 ..
4.5.d:
जिह्वासमुपभोगार्थं यस्यारम्भः स्वकर्मसु ॥
मूल्येनाध्यापयेद्यश्च मूल्येनाधीयते च ये ॥ 38 ॥
4.5.m: One whose enterprise in his own duties is only for the gratification of the tongue, / and he who teaches for a fee, and those who study for a fee;

4.5.s:
vrātyatā vratasaṃtyāgaḥ sarvāhāraniṣevaṇam ..
asaddārābhigamanaṃ śuṣkatarkāvalaṃbanam .. 39 ..
4.5.d:
व्रात्यता व्रतसंत्यागः सर्वाहारनिषेवणम् ॥
असद्दाराभिगमनं शुष्कतर्कावलंबनम् ॥ 39 ॥
4.5.m: Lapsing from caste duties, abandoning vows, consuming all kinds of food, / intercourse with an improper woman, and relying on dry logic;

4.5.s:
devāgnisādhusādhvīnāṃ niṃdā gobrāhmaṇasya ca.
pratyakṣaṃ vā parokṣaṃ vā rājñāṃ maṇḍalikāmapi ..
duḥśīlā nāstikāḥ pāpāḥ sarvaśūnyasya vādinaḥ .. 4.5.40 ..
4.5.d:
देवाग्निसाधुसाध्वीनां निंदा गोब्राह्मणस्य च।
प्रत्यक्षं वा परोक्षं वा राज्ञां मण्डलिकामपि ॥
दुःशीला नास्तिकाः पापाः सर्वशून्यस्य वादिनः ॥ 4.5.40 ॥
4.5.m: Reviling gods, fire, holy men, virtuous women, cattle, and Brahmins, / whether openly or secretly, or [reviling] even kings and vassal rulers, / being ill-behaved, atheists, sinners, and proponents of universal void;

4.5.s:
parvakāle divā caiva viyonau paśuyoniṣu ..
rajasvalānāṃ yonau ca maithunaṃ ca samācaret ..41..
4.5.d:
पर्वकाले दिवा चैव वियोनौ पशुयोनिषु ॥
रजस्वलानां योनौ च मैथुनं च समाचरेत् ॥41॥
4.5.m: And one should [not] engage in sexual intercourse during the sacred festivals, or by day, / or in an unnatural orifice, among beasts, or in the vagina of menstruating women;

4.5.s:
strīputramitrasaṃprīte grāsānnacchedakāśca ye ..
janasyā priyavaktāro dhūrtāḥ samayabhedinaḥ ..42..
4.5.d:
स्त्रीपुत्रमित्रसंप्रीते ग्रासान्नच्छेदकाश्च ये ॥
जनस्या प्रियवक्तारो धूर्ताः समयभेदिनः ॥42॥
4.5.m: And those who withhold mouthfuls of food from beloved wives, sons, and friends, / speakers of unkind words to people, knaves, and violators of agreements;

4.5.s:
bhettā taḍāgacakrāṇāṃ saṃkramāṇāṃ rathasya ca ..
ekapaṃktisthitānāṃ ca pākabhedaṃ karoti yaḥ ..43..
4.5.d:
भेत्ता तडागचक्राणां संक्रमाणां रथस्य च ॥
एकपंक्तिस्थितानां च पाकभेदं करोति यः ॥43॥
4.5.m: A breaker of reservoirs, water-wheels, causeways, and chariots, / and one who discriminates in food served to those seated in a single row;

4.5.s:
ityetaiste narāḥ pāpairupapātakinaḥ smṛtāḥ ..
yuktāstadūnakaiḥ kṣudraiḥ pāpaiḥ pāpatarāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 44 ..
4.5.d:
इत्येतैस्ते नराः पापैरुपपातकिनः स्मृताः ॥
युक्तास्तदूनकैः क्षुद्रैः पापैः पापतराः स्मृताः ॥ 44 ॥
4.5.m: Men are considered guilty of secondary sins by these misdeeds; / joined with minor sins lesser than these, they are considered even more sinful.

4.5.s:
ye gobrāhmaṇakanyānāṃ svāmimitratapasvinām ..
aṃtaraṃ yāṃti kāryeṣu te narā nārakāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 45 ..
4.5.d:
ये गोब्राह्मणकन्यानां स्वामिमित्रतपस्विनाम् ॥
अंतरं यांति कार्येषु ते नरा नारकाः स्मृताः ॥ 45 ॥
4.5.m: Those who cause discord or ruin in the affairs of cattle, Brahmins, maidens, / masters, friends, and ascetics—those men are known as destined for hell.

4.5.s:
paraśriyā ye tapyaṃte ye paradravyasūcakāḥ ..
paravyāpāraniratāḥ parastrīnaradūṣakāḥ .. 46 ..
4.5.d:
परश्रिया ये तप्यंते ये परद्रव्यसूचकाः ॥
परव्यापारनिरताः परस्त्रीनरदूषकाः ॥ 46 ॥
4.5.m: Those who torment themselves over another’s fortune, informants regarding another’s property, / those meddling in others' business, and defilers of others' wives and men;

4.5.s:
dvijāya duḥkhaṃ yaḥ kuryātprakārairbahubhiḥ sadā ..
sevate yo dvijaḥ śūdrāṃ surāṃ jighrati kāmataḥ .. 47 ..
4.5.d:
द्विजाय दुःखं यः कुर्यात्प्रकारैर्बहुभिः सदा ॥
सेवते यो द्विजः शूद्रां सुरां जिघ्रति कामतः ॥ 47 ॥
4.5.m: One who constantly causes distress to a twice-born man in many ways, / a twice-born man who serves a Śūdra woman, and one who willfully smells liquor;

4.5.s:
ye pānābhiratāḥ krūrā ye ca hiṃsāpriyā narāḥ ..
vittārthaṃ ye ca kurvaṃti dānayajñādikāṃ kriyām .. 48 ..
4.5.d:
ये पानाभिरताः क्रूरा ये च हिंसाप्रिया नराः ॥
वित्तार्थं ये च कुर्वंति दानयज्ञादिकां क्रियाम् ॥ 48 ॥
4.5.m: Those men who are devoted to drinking, cruel, and fond of violence, / and those who perform acts such as gifts and sacrifices solely for the sake of wealth;

4.5.s:
goṣṭhāgnijalarathyāsu tarucchāyāmaṭheṣu ca ..
tyajaṃtyamedhyaṃ puruṣā ārāmāyataneṣu ca .. .. 49 ..
4.5.d:
गोष्ठाग्निजलरथ्यासु तरुच्छायामठेषु च ॥
त्यजंत्यमेध्यं पुरुषा आरामायतनेषु च ॥ ॥ 49 ॥
4.5.m: Men who deposit feces or urine in cattle-pens, fire, water, and roadways, / under the shade of trees, in hermitages, in gardens, and in temples;

4.5.s:
madyapānaratā nityaṃ gānavādyaratā narāḥ ..
kelīkalābhujaṃgāśca raṃdhrānveṣaṇatatparāḥ .. 4.5.50 ..
4.5.d:
मद्यपानरता नित्यं गानवाद्यरता नराः ॥
केलीकलाभुजंगाश्च रंध्रान्वेषणतत्पराः ॥ 4.5.50 ॥
4.5.m: Men constantly devoted to drinking liquor, singing, and playing musical instruments, / gallants versed in the arts of love-play, and those intent on seeking out vulnerabilities;

4.5.s:
vaṃśeṣu kāśakāṣṭhaiśca śubhaiḥ śaṃkubhireva vā ..
ye mārgānsamupaghnaṃti parastrīrāharaṃti ca .. 51 ..
4.5.d:
वंशेषु काशकाष्ठैश्च शुभैः शंकुभिरेव वा ॥
ये मार्गान्समुपघ्नंति परस्त्रीराहरंति च ॥ 51 ॥
4.5.m: Those who obstruct roadways with bamboos, kāśa grass, pieces of wood, / or pointed stakes, and those who carry off other men's wives;

4.5.s:
kūṭaśāsanahartāraḥ kūṭakarmakriyāratāḥ ..
kūṭayuddhāśca śastreṇa kūṭasaṃvyavahāriṇaḥ .. 52 ..
4.5.d:
कूटशासनहर्तारः कूटकर्मक्रियारताः ॥
कूटयुद्धाश्च शस्त्रेण कूटसंव्यवहारिणः ॥ 52 ॥
4.5.m: Those who forge royal charters, those engaged in fraudulent acts, / those who fight deceitfully with weapons, and those who trade fraudulently;

4.5.s:
dhanuṣāṃ śalyaśastrāṇāṃ yaḥ kartā yaśca vikrayī ..
nirdayo'tīva bhṛtyeṣu paśūnāṃ damakaśca yaḥ .. 53 ..
4.5.d:
धनुषां शल्यशस्त्राणां यः कर्ता यश्च विक्रयी ॥
निर्दयोऽतीव भृत्येषु पशूनां दमकश्च यः ॥ 53 ॥
4.5.m: He who makes bows, missile-points, and weapons, and he who sells them; / he who is exceedingly cruel toward servants, and he who cruelly tames animals;

4.5.s:
mithyā pravadato vākyamākarṇayati yaḥ śanaiḥ ..
svāmimitragurudrohī māyāvī capalaḥ śaṭhaḥ .. 54 ..
4.5.d:
मिथ्या प्रवदतो वाक्यमाकर्णयति यः शनैः ॥
स्वामिमित्रगुरुद्रोही मायावी चपलः शठः ॥ 54 ॥
4.5.m: He who secretly listens to the words of one who speaks falsely, / one who betrays his master, friend, or guru, one who is deceitful, fickle, and rogue;

4.5.s:
ye bhāryāputramitrāṇi bālavṛddhakṛśāturān ..
bhṛtyānatithibandhūṃśca prabādhante bubhukṣayā .. 55 ..
4.5.d:
ये भार्यापुत्रमित्राणि बालवृद्धकृशातुरान् ॥
भृत्यानतिथिबन्धूंश्च प्रबाधन्ते बुभुक्षया ॥ 55 ॥
4.5.m: Those who torment their wife, sons, and friends, the young, old, emaciated, and sick, / servants, guests, and relatives with hunger;

4.5.s:
yaḥ svayaṃ miṣṭamaśnāti viprāyānyatprayacchati ..
vṛthāpākaḥ sa vijñeyo brahmavādiṣu garhitaḥ .. 56 ..
4.5.d:
यः स्वयं मिष्टमश्नाति विप्रायान्यत्प्रयच्छति ॥
वृथापाकः स विज्ञेयो ब्रह्मवादिषु गर्हितः ॥ 56 ॥
4.5.m: He who eats delicacies himself and gives something else to a Brahmin— / he is to be known as a vain-cook, condemned among knowers of the Veda;

4.5.s:
niyamānsvayamādāya ye tyajaṃtyajiteṃdriyāḥ ..
pravrajyāvāsino ye ca rahasyānāṃ ca bhedakāḥ .. 57 ..
4.5.d:
नियमान्स्वयमादाय ये त्यजंत्यजितेंद्रियाः ॥
प्रव्रज्यावासिनो ये च रहस्यानां च भेदकाः ॥ 57 ॥
4.5.m: Those who, having undertaken rules of conduct themselves, abandon them due to uncontrolled senses, / those residing in ascetic orders [who break their rules], and revealers of secrets;

4.5.s:
tāḍayaṃti ca vegādye śapaṃti ca muhurmuhuḥ ..
durbalāṃśca na puṣṇaṃti punastānvāhayaṃti ca .. 56 ..
4.5.d:
ताडयंति च वेगाद्ये शपंति च मुहुर्मुहुः ॥
दुर्बलांश्च न पुष्णंति पुनस्तान्वाहयंति च ॥ 56 ॥
4.5.m: Those who violently strike [beasts] and curse them again and again, / and do not nourish weak ones, yet continue to drive them;

4.5.s:
pīḍayaṃtyatibhāreṇa sakṣatānvāhayaṃti ca ..
sārddhayāmāduparitaḥ saṃyukteṣu ca bhuṃjate .. 59 ..
4.5.d:
पीडयंत्यतिभारेण सक्षतान्वाहयंति च ॥
सार्द्धयामादुपरितः संयुक्तेषु च भुंजते ॥ 59 ॥
4.5.m: Those who torment them with excessive loads and drive wounded animals, / and eat while the yoked beasts remain beyond a watch and a half;

4.5.s:
ye bhagnakṣatarogārtānsvagorūpānbubhukṣayā ..
na pālayaṃti yatnena te goptā nārakā narāḥ .. 4.5.60 ..
4.5.d:
ये भग्नक्षतरोगार्तान्स्वगोरूपान्बुभुक्षया ॥
न पालयंति यत्नेन ते गोप्ता नारका नराः ॥ 4.5.60 ॥
4.5.m: Those keepers who do not care diligently for their own cattle / that are broken, wounded, or diseased, and starving—those men are destined for hell.

4.5.s:
vṛṣāṇāṃ vṛṣaṇānyeva pāpiṣṭhā gālayaṃti ye ..
vāhayaṃti ca gāṃ vadhyāṃ te mahānārakāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 61 ..
4.5.d:
वृषाणां वृषणान्येव पापिष्ठा गालयंति ये ॥
वाहयंति च गां वध्यां ते महानारकाः स्मृताः ॥ 61 ॥
4.5.m: Those vile sinners who castrate the testicles of bulls, / and drive cows to slaughter—they are known as dwellers of great hells.

4.5.s:
āśramaṃ samanuprāptaṃ kṣuttṛṣṇāśramapīḍitam ..
ye'tithiṃ nābhimanyaṃte te vai nirayagāminaḥ..62..
4.5.d:
आश्रमं समनुप्राप्तं क्षुत्तृष्णाश्रमपीडितम् ॥
येऽतिथिं नाभिमन्यंते ते वै निरयगामिनः॥62॥
4.5.m: Those who do not honour a guest who has arrived at their hermitage / afflicted with hunger, thirst, and exhaustion, indeed go to hell.

4.5.s:
anāthaṃ vikalaṃ dīnaṃ bālaṃ vṛddhaṃ kṛśāturam..
nānukaṃpaṃti ye mūḍhāste yānti nirayārṇavam .. 63 ..
4.5.d:
अनाथं विकलं दीनं बालं वृद्धं कृशातुरम्॥
नानुकंपंति ये मूढास्ते यान्ति निरयार्णवम् ॥ 63 ॥
4.5.m: Those fools who do not pity the helpless, the crippled, the wretched, / the child, the aged, the emaciated, and the sick, go to the ocean of hell.

4.5.s:
ajāviko māhiṣikaḥ sāmudro vṛṣalīpatiḥ ..
śūdraviṭkṣatravṛttiśca nārakī syāddvijādhamaḥ .. 64 ..
4.5.d:
अजाविको माहिषिकः सामुद्रो वृषलीपतिः ॥
शूद्रविट्क्षत्रवृत्तिश्च नारकी स्याद्द्विजाधमः ॥ 64 ॥
4.5.m: The keeper of goats and sheep, the keeper of buffaloes, a seafarer, the husband of a Śūdra woman, / and the vilest of twice-born men who lives by the occupations of Śūdras, Vaiśyas, or Kṣatriyas, becomes a dweller of hell.

4.5.s:
śilpinaḥ kārukā vaidyā hemakārā naṭā dvijāḥ ..
kṛtakaukṣeya sayuktāstathānye nārakāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 65 ..
4.5.d:
शिल्पिनः कारुका वैद्या हेमकारा नटा द्विजाः ॥
कृतकौक्षेय सयुक्तास्तथान्ये नारकाः स्मृताः ॥ 65 ॥
4.5.m: Twice-born artisans, craftsmen, physicians, goldsmiths, and actors, / along with those bearing hired swords—such others are known as hell-dwellers.

4.5.s:
yaścoditamatikramya svecchayā vā haretkaram ..
narake tu sa pacyeta yaśca daṃḍarucirbhavet .. 66 ..
4.5.d:
यश्चोदितमतिक्रम्य स्वेच्छया वा हरेत्करम् ॥
नरके तु स पच्येत यश्च दंडरुचिर्भवेत् ॥ 66 ॥
4.5.m: And he who exceeds the prescribed rate or seizes taxes arbitrarily, / and he who delights in excessive punishment, is cooked in hell.

4.5.s:
utkocakairadhikṛtaistaskaraiśca prapīḍyate ..
yasya rājñaḥ prajā ruṣṭā pacyate narakeṣu saḥ .. 67 ..
4.5.d:
उत्कोचकैरधिकृतैस्तस्करैश्च प्रपीड्यते ॥
यस्य राज्ञः प्रजा रुष्टा पच्यते नरकेषु सः ॥ 67 ॥
4.5.m: That king whose subjects, enraged, are oppressed by bribe-takers, / officials, and thieves, is cooked in hells.

4.5.s:
ye dvijāḥ pratigṛhṇaṃti nṛpasyānyāyavartinaḥ ..
prayāṃti tepi ghorāṇi narakāṇi na saṃśayaḥ ..68..
4.5.d:
ये द्विजाः प्रतिगृह्णंति नृपस्यान्यायवर्तिनः ॥
प्रयांति तेपि घोराणि नरकाणि न संशयः ॥68॥
4.5.m: Those twice-born men who accept gifts from an unjust king / go to dreadful hells; there is no doubt about this.

4.5.s:
pāradārikacaurāṇāṃ yatpāpaṃ pārthivasya tat ..
bhavedarakṣatastasmādghorastasya pratigrahaḥ .. 69 ..
4.5.d:
पारदारिकचौराणां यत्पापं पार्थिवस्य तत् ॥
भवेदरक्षतस्तस्माद्घोरस्तस्य प्रतिग्रहः ॥ 69 ॥
4.5.m: Whatever sin belongs to adulterers and thieves belongs to the king / who fails to protect [his subjects]; therefore, receiving gifts from him is dreadful.

4.5.s:
acauraṃ cauravatpaśyeccoraṃ vā'caurarūpavat ..
avicārya nṛpastasmāddhātayannarakaṃ vrajet .. 4.5.70 ..
4.5.d:
अचौरं चौरवत्पश्येच्चोरं वाऽचौररूपवत् ॥
अविचार्य नृपस्तस्माद्धातयन्नरकं व्रजेत् ॥ 4.5.70 ॥
4.5.m: A king who views a non-thief as a thief or a thief as a non-thief, / and executes them without inquiry, goes to hell.

4.5.s:
ghṛtatailānnapānāni madhumāṃsasurāsavam ..
guḍekṣukṣāraśākāni dadhimūlaphalāni ca .. 71 ..
4.5.d:
घृततैलान्नपानानि मधुमांससुरासवम् ॥
गुडेक्षुक्षारशाकानि दधिमूलफलानि च ॥ 71 ॥
4.5.m: Ghee, oil, food, drinks, honey, meat, spirituous liquor, / jaggery, sugarcane, alkaline salt, vegetables, curds, roots, and fruits;

4.5.s:
tṛṇaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ puṣpapatramauṣadhaṃ kāṃsyabhājanam ..
upānacchatraśakaṭamāsanaṃ śayanāṃbaram .. 72 ..
4.5.d:
तृणं काष्ठं पुष्पपत्रमौषधं कांस्यभाजनम् ॥
उपानच्छत्रशकटमासनं शयनांबरम् ॥ 72 ॥
4.5.m: Grass, wood, flowers, leaves, medicine, bronze vessels, / shoes, parasols, carts, seats, beds, and clothing;

4.5.s:
tāmraṃ sīsaṃ trapuṃ kācaṃ śaṃkhādyaṃ ca jalodbhavam ..
vārkṣaṃ vā vaiṇavādyaṃ vā gṛheṣūpaskarāṇi ca .. 73 ..
4.5.d:
ताम्रं सीसं त्रपुं काचं शंखाद्यं च जलोद्भवम् ॥
वार्क्षं वा वैणवाद्यं वा गृहेषूपस्कराणि च ॥ 73 ॥
4.5.m: Copper, lead, tin, glass, items born of water such as conches, / things made of wood or bamboo, and household utensils;

4.5.s:
ūrṇākārpāsakauśeyabhaṃgapaṭṭodbhavāni ca ..
sthūlasūkṣmāṇi vastrāṇi ye ca lobhāddharaṃti ca .. 74 ..
4.5.d:
ऊर्णाकार्पासकौशेयभंगपट्टोद्भवानि च ॥
स्थूलसूक्ष्माणि वस्त्राणि ये च लोभाद्धरंति च ॥ 74 ॥
4.5.m: And those who, out of greed, take fabrics coarse or fine, / made from wool, cotton, silk, hemp, or bark-fibre—

4.5.s:
evamādīni cānyāni dravyāṇi vividhāni ca ..
narakāṇi dhruvaṃ yāṃti narā vā nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 75 ..
4.5.d:
एवमादीनि चान्यानि द्रव्याणि विविधानि च ॥
नरकाणि ध्रुवं यांति नरा वा नात्र संशयः ॥ 75 ॥
4.5.m: Men who steal these and various other such goods / certainly go to hells; there is no doubt here.

4.5.s:
yadvā tadvā paradravyamapi sarṣapamātrakam ..
apahṛtya naro yāti narakaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 76 ..
4.5.d:
यद्वा तद्वा परद्रव्यमपि सर्षपमात्रकम् ॥
अपहृत्य नरो याति नरकं नात्र संशयः ॥ 76 ॥
4.5.m: By stealing another’s property, whatever it may be, / even the size of a mustard seed, a man goes to hell; there is no doubt here.

4.5.s:
evamādyairnaraḥ pāpairutkrāṃteḥ samanaṃtaram ..
śarīraṃ yātanārthāya pūrvākāramavāpnuyāt .. 77 ..
4.5.d:
एवमाद्यैर्नरः पापैरुत्क्रांतेः समनंतरम् ॥
शरीरं यातनार्थाय पूर्वाकारमवाप्नुयात् ॥ 77 ॥
4.5.m: Immediately after departing [this life] through such sins, / a man obtains a body of the former shape for the sake of torture.

4.5.s:
yamalokaṃ vrajettena śarīreṇa yamājñayā ..
yamadūtairmahāghorairnīyamānaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ .. 78 ..
4.5.d:
यमलोकं व्रजेत्तेन शरीरेण यमाज्ञया ॥
यमदूतैर्महाघोरैर्नीयमानः सुदुःखितः ॥ 78 ॥
4.5.m: By that body he goes to the realm of Yama by Yama's command, / led by the exceedingly terrible messengers of Yama, in great suffering.

4.5.s:
tiryaṅmānuṣadehānāmadharmaniratātmanām ..
dharmarājaḥ smṛtaḥ śāstā sughorairvividhairvadhaiḥ .. 79 ..
4.5.d:
तिर्यङ्मानुषदेहानामधर्मनिरतात्मनाम् ॥
धर्मराजः स्मृतः शास्ता सुघोरैर्विविधैर्वधैः ॥ 79 ॥
4.5.m: Dharmarāja is known as the punisher of those in animal and human bodies / who are devoted to unrighteousness, by means of various dreadful executions.

4.5.s:
vinayācārayuktānāṃ pramādātskhalitātmanām ..
prāyaścitterguruḥ śāstā na ca tairdṛśyate yamaḥ .. 4.5.80 ..
4.5.d:
विनयाचारयुक्तानां प्रमादात्स्खलितात्मनाम् ॥
प्रायश्चित्तेर्गुरुः शास्ता न च तैर्दृश्यते यमः ॥ 4.5.80 ॥
4.5.m: For those endowed with modesty and proper conduct whose minds have stumbled through negligence, / the guru is the punisher through expiation, and Yama is not seen by them.

4.5.s:
pāradārikacaurāṇāmanyāyavyavahāriṇām ..
nṛpatiḥ śāsakasteṣāṃ pracchannānāṃ ca dharmarāṭ .. 81 ..
4.5.d:
पारदारिकचौराणामन्यायव्यवहारिणाम् ॥
नृपतिः शासकस्तेषां प्रच्छन्नानां च धर्मराट् ॥ 81 ॥
4.5.m: The king is the punisher of adulterers, thieves, and those who conduct unlawful dealings; and Dharmarāj is [the punisher] of those who remain secret.

4.5.s:
tasmātkṛtasya pāpasya prāyaścittaṃ samācaret ..
nābhuktasyānyathā nāśaḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi .. 82 ..
4.5.d:
तस्मात्कृतस्य पापस्य प्रायश्चित्तं समाचरेत् ॥
नाभुक्तस्यान्यथा नाशः कल्पकोटिशतैरपि ॥ 82 ॥
4.5.m: Therefore, one should perform expiation for an act of sin committed; otherwise, what is not experienced is not destroyed even in hundreds of millions of kalpas.

4.5.s:
yaḥ karoti svayaṃ karma kārayedvāpi moda yet ..
kāyena manasā vācā tasya cādhogatiḥ phalam .. 83 ..
4.5.d:
यः करोति स्वयं कर्म कारयेद्वापि मोद येत् ॥
कायेन मनसा वाचा तस्य चाधोगतिः फलम् ॥ 83 ॥
4.5.m: Whether one commits an action oneself, causes [another] to do it, or rejoices [in it] by body, mind, or speech, its fruit is a fall to a low state.

4.5.s:
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktāḥ pāpabhedāḥ sasādhanāḥ ..
kathyate gatayaścitrā narāṇāṃ pāpakarmaṇām .. 84 ..
4.5.d:
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्ताः पापभेदाः ससाधनाः ॥
कथ्यते गतयश्चित्रा नराणां पापकर्मणाम् ॥ 84 ॥
4.5.m: Thus the varieties of sins along with their means have been briefly stated. Now the manifold paths of evil-doing men are described.

4.5.s:
vākkāyacittajanitairbahubhedabhinnaiḥ kṛtyaiḥ śubhāśubhaphalodayahetubhūtaiḥ .. bhāsvatsureśabhuvanaṃ narakānanekānsaṃprāpnuvaṃti manujā manujeṃdracandra..85..
śubhāśubhaphalanirdeśavarṇanam
4.5.d:
वाक्कायचित्तजनितैर्बहुभेदभिन्नैः कृत्यैः शुभाशुभफलोदयहेतुभूतैः ॥ भास्वत्सुरेशभुवनं नरकाननेकान्संप्राप्नुवंति मनुजा मनुजेंद्रचन्द्र॥85॥
शुभाशुभफलनिर्देशवर्णनम्
4.5.m:
By actions produced by speech, body, and mind, divided into many kinds, which cause the arising of auspicious and inauspicious fruits, men reach the shining realm of the lord of the gods or many hells, O moon among kings!
Description of the Instruction on Auspicious and Inauspicious Fruits
